scope: C0 and C1 stage-local proofs: test_e3_stage_local, test_e3_stage_local_qsa

leaves.name: ring-buffer
leaves.equivalence: same slot rule as acquire_write (written flag, per-reader read flags, one index per reader), read through the same get_metadata/current_idx surface BoundedSender uses; every envelope is pickled and each reader gets its own copy; the ring has the pinned default of 10 slots
leaves.cannot_prove: shared memory, ZMQ overflow, memory ordering between processes

leaves.name: reply-queue
leaves.equivalence: single-writer single-reader FIFO with a timeout that raises TimeoutError; the wire tuple is pickled; the real ReplyTransport and its receiver threads read it

leaves.name: worker-loop
leaves.equivalence: the same hook calls in the same order as the generated text at executor_hooks._EXECUTOR_FORWARD (worker_rpc_begin, the method, worker_rpc_returned, the output-rank guard, worker_handle_output, worker_enqueue_reply); the generated source itself runs in test_e3_native_reply_hol; replies are written synchronously, without the async output thread, so head-of-line blocking behind decode is not modelled here
leaves.cannot_prove: decode occupancy of the worker main thread; that is a box receipt

leaves.name: stock-rpc
leaves.replaces: a stock execute_model or sample_tokens enqueue on the same ring
leaves.equivalence: takes one slot under the same rule and asserts it would not block; its reply path (output_rank -1) is not under test
leaves.cannot_prove: stock future handling; test_e3_stock_rpc_credits and test_e3_native_reply_hol cover it

leaves.name: device-ledger
leaves.replaces: nothing: it records around the real dispatcher handlers and the PP channel leaf
leaves.equivalence: an observer of per-rank command order and PP identity; numerics follow from equal per-rank order only if each handler is deterministic in that order
leaves.cannot_prove: numerics; the matched box arms compare real bytes

leaves.name: worker-owners
leaves.replaces: CUDA events and streams, the lane forward, the chunk factory, the PP channel's NCCL calls
leaves.equivalence: as declared in test_e3_r4_worker_bridge: events resolve only when the test completes them, and the PP channel leaf withholds a send's completion until its receive is posted (rendezvous); LaneDispatcher, NativeWorkerBridge, WorkerState, route controller and graph router are real

leaves.name: qsa-stack
leaves.replaces: the device, the model and the communicator under the real generated QSA source, QsaLayerDriver and QsaPrefillOperation
leaves.equivalence: ProfileNetwork's declared leaves in test_e3_native_schedule_profile, on the per-rank ring
leaves.cannot_prove: TP collective liveness on multiple GPUs

leaves.name: auto-arm-state
leaves.replaces: AutoArmPolicy.manual_owned/phase/active and the armed admission intent
leaves.equivalence: the real _progress_owned predicate reads exactly these fields; the real policy is in test_native41_autoarm

leaves.name: scheduler-and-manager
leaves.replaces: stock Scheduler and KVCacheManager for C0's protocol proofs
leaves.equivalence: C0 calls allocate_slots and cache_blocks at the same points with the same arguments as the frozen path (compared in Identity); the real manager proof is the C1 provisional-allocation proof
